policy.excluded: Geographic/map intent, or interaction intrinsic to the displayed chart; static optional interaction is otherwise noted.

policy.preprocessing_or_adapter: Plot can plausibly be expressed in current native marks, but original data transforms, encodings, or configuration require rewriting or preprocessing.
policy.compiler_gap: Current backend lacks a required semantic mark/layout/style feature; cannot claim like-for-like support.
policy.verified: Reserved for passing original-spec normalization, native conversion, successful LaTeX compilation, and reviewed numerical/visual parity; none currently qualified.
